---
name: agent-customize
description: Customize one Ventura Agents II prompt for a concrete organization while preserving mission limits metrics and escalation behavior. Use when adapting an existing specialist to real processes and tools. Do not use when the requested role is outside this catalog or when only selecting an agent.
---

# Agent customize

- Start from the closest existing specialist prompt.
- Add approved organization terminology processes metrics and operating constraints.
- Preserve the prompt's mission and human-escalation boundaries.
- Add only integrations that actually exist in the target environment.
- Keep permissions authentication and authorization enforced outside the prompt.
- Remove conflicting or duplicate instructions.
- Record assumptions introduced by the customization.
